Market today: The mood is cautious. Bond yields are ticking higher despite weak jobs data, suggesting inflation or hawkish Fed concerns are overriding. This is a headwind for your growth-oriented tech and chip names, especially on margin.

Your holdings: SOXL (-26.83%) and SPAL (-24.55%) are both leveraged ETFs deep in the red with "SELL" status. Their decay and fast moves are amplified by your margin, demanding immediate attention.

Watch: Keep a close eye on bond yields; continued increases will pressure your portfolio. Also, monitor your leveraged positions for any further downside.

Bottom line: Prioritize risk management on your leveraged, underperforming positions to protect your capital.
plays: Review SOXL's stop loss. At -26.83% and leveraged, this position needs tight risk control to prevent further losses.
Re-evaluate SPAL's stop loss. Similar to SOXL, its -24.55% loss and leveraged nature require careful management.
No new buys today - hold and watch. The market's current mood with rising yields doesn't present compelling new entry points for your tech-heavy, margin-fueled portfolio.
